import amqp from "amqplib";

export async function publishOrder(channel: amqp.Channel) {
  channel.publish("orders.exchange", "order.created", Buffer.from("{}"));
}

export async function sendDirect(channel: amqp.Channel) {
  channel.sendToQueue("audit.queue", Buffer.from("{}"));
}

export async function consume(channel: amqp.Channel) {
  await channel.consume("orders.queue", (msg) => {});
}
